entities.summary: Ronald Keith Moore is an American former professional basketball player. He played in the National Basketball Association (NBA) for the Detroit Pistons and Phoenix Suns during the 1987–88 season. Moore also played in the Continental Basketball Association, United States Basketball League, and various professional leagues in France, Argentina, and Cyprus. He served as player-assistant coach for the Westchester Kings in 1997.
